_comment: AE4.5 generator INPUT — the seven PO-approved axes of the authorization matrix.
⛔ THIS FILE DECLARES THE GRID, NOT ITS CONTENTS. Every cell here has axis coordinates
and a stable id and NO EXPECTED VALUE. Filling in expectations is AE4.3 (the staff_admin
permission matrix, PO-approved) and AE4.5 (the differential oracle). AE4 Increment 1 ships
the machinery only — a cell list with expectations invented by the generator's author would
be exactly the 'approve a legacy defect into the matrix' trap that PA-F8 exists to stop.
⚠ SUBJECT SCOPE: `staff_admin` only. AE4 substitutes exactly one role (ADR 0155 D7); AE5
adds one role at a time through the same template. Widening `subjectRoles` is what an AE5

persona._source: AE0.5 Axis 1 — the seeded roster. ⛔ NO SEEDED PERSONA HOLDS ANYTHING OUTSIDE ITS HOME ORG, so `cross_org_actor` is fixture-only and is tagged as such.

values.subject_holder: holds the subject role at the scope under test
values.other_commission_holder: holds the subject role at a DIFFERENT commission in the same org
values.cross_org_actor: holds the subject role in another organization — FIXTURE-ONLY, no seeded persona can fill this

role._source: AE0.5 Axis 2 — 11 role codes across 5 independent definition surfaces.

activeContext._source: AE0.5 Axis 3 — role-valued, NOT (role, scope)-valued. ABSENT is a real value and fails closed.

values.other_role: active_role = some other role the caller holds
values.absent: no active_role claim — caller holds zero or many role types; forces /selecionar-perfil

scope._source: AE0.5 Axis 4 — 3 kinds + zero-scope. staff_admin is commission-scoped per memberships_scope_shape.

values.own_commission: the commission the caller holds the role at
values.sibling_commission: another commission in the same hospital/org

operation._source: AE0.5 Axis 5 — THREE TIERS WITH NO SHARED NAMESPACE (finding F2). ⛔ `read_cases` (administrativo) and `read_case_content` (_case_caps bit) are one word apart and mean different things; AE4.3 must resolve that collision rather than mechanically unify them.

principalState._source: AE0.5 Axis 6a — an input to EVERY cell, for actor and target alike.

values.offboarded: no active affiliation. ✅ RULED — AE2.0 was decided 2026-08-27: last-org retention, SUBSET capabilities (ADR 0163, amended by 0164 which constrains only its enforcement timing; AE2 is complete). ⛔ AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS FILE CALLED THESE CELLS UNFILLABLE 'pending AE2.0's ruling' — FALSE, and it read as diligence, so nobody would have re-checked it. For the staff_admin matrix the value is an ORDINARY FILLABLE COORDINATE: ADR 0163 governs who may ADMINISTER an offboarded person (lifecycle / cpf_change), which is not staff_admin's territory, and CLAUDE.md Rule 13 settles the rest — 0163 is not an exception, 'an ended row decides WHERE, never WHETHER'. A memberships row GRANTS; an affiliation only LOCATES. AE4.3 derives the expected value like any other cell.

resourceLifecycle._source: AE0.5 Axis 6b — per resource family. A predicate can be true at every instant and false across a REVERSAL, so a transition-dependent cell records the transition, not the state.

values.not_applicable: the operation acts on no lifecycled resource

sensitivity._source: AE0.5 Axis 7 — feeds authz.permissions.sensitivity_ceiling (DEFERRED in Increment 1, ADR 0172).

values.none: ordinary governance content; the platform is PHI-free by design outside three modules
values.restricted_personal: cpf / date_of_birth / phone — moved to profile_private_details by AE3

denyClasses._comment: ⛔ Deny classes are AXIS VALUES, not prose (plan PA-F7). Each names the axis coordinates that constitute it, so the generator can label a cell mechanically.

constraintRules._comment: Rules that EXCLUDE IMPOSSIBLE COMBINATIONS. Implemented as code in the generator; declared here so the exclusion is reviewable and so each skipped cell can name the rule that skipped it. ⛔ 'exhaustive' must be an output of the artifact, never a review adjective.
constraintRules.scope_must_match_role_scope_kind: staff_admin is commission-scoped (memberships_scope_shape), so zero_scope is impossible for it.
constraintRules.anonymous_has_no_active_context: An unauthenticated caller cannot carry an active_role claim; only activeContext=absent is reachable.
constraintRules.anonymous_holds_no_role_state: principalState describes a profile row; an anonymous caller has none. Only principalState=active is enumerated, as a placeholder coordinate.
constraintRules.third_party_ops_are_active_context_indep: AE0.5 Axis 3 asymmetry 2 — app.has_role consults active_role ONLY when p_user_id = auth.uid(). Operations on another person skip the filter entirely, so activeContext is not a free variable for them. A DERIVED PROPERTY, recorded once here rather than rediscovered per role.
constraintRules.operation_determines_sensitivity: ⭐ For the _case_caps tier the OPERATION IS THE SENSITIVITY — read_standard_phi IS the standard-PHI bit. Crossing every case operation with every sensitivity value enumerates states like 'read_standard_phi at sensitivity none', which name nothing reachable. Not a simplification; it is what the bitmask means.
constraintRules.lifecycle_requires_lifecycled_resource: resourceLifecycle other than not_applicable is only reachable for operations acting on a lifecycled resource. ⚠ EMPTY IN INCREMENT 1 BY PROPERTY, NOT BY STUB: Axis 5's three tiers are today's vocabulary (role-at-scope predicates, _case_caps bits, administrativo capabilities) and none of them acts on a form version or a response, which are the families Axis 6b enumerates. AE4.3 populates the per-operation map when it derives the form/response permission codes, and the cell count grows THEN — attributable to that derivation instead of buried in an initial cross-product.
constraintRules.deny_class_collapses_downstream_axes: ⭐ Once a caller is anonymous, deactivated, or acting on a foreign org's commission, the answer is DENY FOR THAT REASON, and enumerating the remaining axes underneath it produces N cells asserting the same thing for the same reason — the same test copied N times, inflating the coverage report into a number nobody can act on. ⛔ The collapse NEVER applies to the axis the deny is ON: an `inactive` deny still enumerates every principalState.
constraintRules.operation_tier_excluded_for_role: A subject role may have no operations in a whole tier. Declared as a spec-level `excludeOperationTiers` list; AE5 uses it per role.
constraintRules._retired__offboarded_has_no_approved_rul: ⛔ RETIRED 2026-09-01 — THIS RULE WAS NEVER TRUE. It claimed the fully-offboarded value blocked on AE2.0's PO decision, and marked 91 cells `unfillable` on that basis. AE2.0 was RULED 2026-08-27 (ADR 0163, last-org retention) — four days before this file was written. Nothing was pending. Kept as a retired key rather than deleted because an exclusion attributed to an unmade ruling READS AS CARE and is therefore the kind nobody re-checks; the 91 cells are now ordinary fillable cells that AE4.3 must approve expected results for. No `unfillable` flag is emitted any more.
